title: Desarmadero Operations Prototype
description: Gave the client a clickable sales workflow before the full build so they could validate the operating model.
seoDescription: How one discovery call became an operations prototype, PRD, specification, and live demo for an auto-dismantling yard.
role: Product direction, specification, and prototype delivery
constraints: The client knew the business workflow, but the operating model was spread across paper budget sheets, WhatsApp, Excel, and memory.
The prototype needed to prove understanding before scope and pricing decisions, not pretend to be the full production system.
problem: A returning client wanted to run a 301-position yard, but its workflow was spread across one discovery call, paper budget sheets, WhatsApp, Excel, and memory.
solution: Mapped the workflow from a discovery call, wrote the PRD and functional spec, then built a role-based prototype the client could click through before committing to the full scope.
result: The client could validate the operating model through a working app instead of abstract requirements.
The prototype translated a spoken workflow spread across several tools into a structured product plan with a live demo, PRD, functional spec, and future phases.
The client left with the discovery record, product plan, working prototype, and a clearer basis for deciding what to build next.
deliveryHighlights: A live role-based prototype, seeded demo, discovery transcript, PRD, functional spec, and prototype screenshots.
The prototype covers counter sales, cash-desk release, dismantle assignment, yard-map search, and a mobile dismantler view.
Five roles were modeled with separate surfaces: administrator, seller, cash desk, dismantle manager, and dismantler.
